So the last commit we made had to do with supressing some large chunks of text in the github report. I noticed this commit https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll/commit/3e6a0519acb8396e8c650ed4f0a5bd8790351305#comments which had around 100 comments and several look like
gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/gyrokinetic/regressiondb:gyrokinetic/creg/rt_gk_cbc_2x2v_p1:607: WARNING: Time-step dt = 1.5263e-14 is below 0.001*dt_init ... num_failures = 1

We do want to report that these happened, but we don't need to report every single one. Make the report more consise, but still report the valuable information

I’ll inspect the report generator and the last change, then consolidate repeated time-step warnings while preserving useful details about the affected tests. I’m using the directory-structure skill to locate the reporting code.
